source.label: Executed rolling-origin forecasts
source.description: Full test excludes the sparse Claude groups. Common Claude origins scores all models on 14 shared, complete 12-week paths. Claude groups average three saved calls per origin, using 156 weeks of input; their intervals are model-generated, not calibrated. 9 selection origins in Jan 2023–Apr 2024; 40 calibration origins Jul 2024–Apr 2025; all calibration outcomes known by Jun 30 2025. 66 weekly test origins; 63 matured 4-week and 55 matured 12-week forecasts. Statistical history window 520 weeks, Chronos 512 weeks.
caveats: Dataset values are supplied by the user; original-source and real-time vintage verification remains pending.
Historical event flags are excluded from the lab statistical models; Claude context prompts include unverified repository news.

10th and 90th empirical forecast-error quantiles by model and horizon on Jul 2024–Apr 2025 origins, all target outcomes known by 2025-06-30. 40 overlapping calibration origins; intervals are exploratory and finite-sample uncertain.
Nominal 80% bands under-cover this supplied test period. Coverage is reported rather than assumed.
Chronos uses a pretrained model; full training-data overlap cannot be ruled out.
Retrospective prompts; pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
Context adds identity, dates, crude prices and unverified repository news together.
